caption: The drawing depicts a rusted metal door handle and latch set, mounted on a vertically oriented rectangular backplate with decorative scalloped edges at the top and bottom. The backplate has four visible screw holes, two near the top and two near the bottom, with signs of wear and rust spread unevenly across its surface in varying shades of brown and orange. Attached to the lower portion of the backplate is a curved handle, which has two distinct metal bands encircling it near its midpoint; these bands appear darker, possibly black or a darker shade of brown, and have a slightly reflective quality. The upper section of the backplate has a horizontal latch with a flattened thumb piece extending outward and ending in a small, oval-shaped pad for pressing, while the opposite end of the latch curves backward into a hook shape. The background is a plain, untextured off-white or cream color. The artist’s name, “FRITZ BOEHMER,” is inscribed in small, fine text at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Door Latch
